eyebrow: What a real model card contains
code:
Model Details    -- architecture, version, license
Intended Use     -- what it's for, what it's NOT
Training Data     -- sources, known gaps
Evaluation Results -- real numbers, from Ch.2's evals
Ethical Considerations -- bias findings, known risks
Caveats & Limitations  -- where it's known to fail
caption: Each section answers a question someone will actually ask before trusting the model.
